name: octopus-reef
description: Reef — the governed agentic engineering workspace. An open, evidence-backed alternative to closed agentic IDEs: every agent action is a tamper-evident, replayable, verifiable session.
author: Ran Tao <ran@octopusos.ai>

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/engine packages/protocol packages/driver-claude packages/server packages/cli
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/engine packages/protocol packages/driver-claude packages/server packages/cli --noEmit || tsc -b packages/engine packages/protocol packages/driver-claude packages/server packages/cli
scripts.verify:all: npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
